name: 42-realtime-messages-pgss
sql: select queryid, userid::regrole::text as role_name, left(query, 200) as query_head, calls, rows, wal_bytes from extensions.pg_stat_statements where query ilike '%messages%' and (query ilike '%insert%' or query ilike '%realtime%') order by wal_bytes::numeric desc nulls last limit 15
